description: AbstractMqttConsumerActor.java defines an abstract superclass for MQTT consumer actors in a HiveMQ client context, providing methods for handling MQTT messages, extracting headers and payloads, converting messages to ExternalMessage objects, and managing acknowledgments.

classes.name: AbstractMqttConsumerActor
classes.description: Abstract class providing common MQTT message processing functionality for HiveMQ MQTT clients, handling message extraction, conversion, and acknowledgment.

methods.name: getPublishMessageClass
methods.description: Abstract method to return the class object of the MQTT message type.

methods.name: extractHeadersMapFromMqttMessage
methods.description: Extracts MQTT-related headers from the message and returns as a HashMap.

methods.name: getPayload
methods.description: Abstract method to extract payload from message.

methods.name: getTopic
methods.description: Abstract method to extract topic string from message.

methods.name: getQoS
methods.description: Abstract method to extract QoS level from message.

methods.name: isRetain
methods.description: Abstract method to determine if the message has the retain flag set.

methods.name: sendPubAck
methods.description: Abstract method to acknowledge message receipt.

methods.name: createReceive
methods.description: Creates the message handling receive builder for this actor.

methods.name: log
methods.description: Returns the logging adapter used by this actor.

methods.name: handleMqttMessage
methods.description: Processes incoming MQTT messages, converting them to ExternalMessage and forwarding.

methods.name: hiveToExternalMessage
methods.description: Converts HiveMQ MQTT message to an ExternalMessage, extracting headers and payload, handling exceptions.

methods.name: getHeaderPlaceholder
methods.description: Generates a placeholder string for header keys.

methods.name: reject
methods.description: Handles rejecting or redelivering a message based on redelivery policy.

methods.name: isDryRun
methods.description: Checks if the actor is in dry run mode.
